Sits in a corner with a toy

qs.q: Which of the following represents the major stressor of hospitalization for children from middle infancy throughout the preschool years?
qs.ex: من نص سنة الأولى لحد الـ preschool أكبر ضغط في المستشفى هو قلق الانفصال.

qs.q: Which of the following should the nurse do to prevent separation anxiety in a hospitalized toddler?
opts: Assume the parental role when parents are not present
Limit visits by siblings and relatives
Establish a routine similar to the child's home
Rotate nursing staff so the child becomes comfortable
qs.ex: علشان نمنع قلق الانفصال: نعمل روتين شبه روتين البيت.

qs.q: Attendance of parents during painful procedures on their toddlers should be:
opts: Based on individual assessment of parents
Based on the type of procedure to be performed
Discouraged for the benefit of parents and child
qs.ex: وجود الأهل مع الـ toddler في الإجراءات المؤلمة بنشجعه ونسمح بيه.

qs.q: Which of the following substances increases pain sensation?
qs.ex: الـ Histamine بيزوّد الإحساس بالألم.

qs.q: Regression is a reaction to hospitalization; ...... are at high risk for it.
qs.ex: الـ Regression (يرجع لتصرفات أصغر من سنه) أكتر عند الـ preschoolers.

qs.q: Which one of the following stressors most affects a 2-year-old toddler?
qs.ex: أكتر حاجة بتأثر على طفل سنتين: البعد عن أهله.

qs.q: The nurse best describes intermittent pain as pain that:
opts: Moves from one area to another
qs.ex: الألم المتقطع (intermittent): بيقف ويرجع تاني.

qs.q: In the despair phase of separation anxiety the child behaves as follows:
opts: Shows signs of interest in the surroundings
Avoids and rejects contact with strangers
Loud cry, scream and search for parent with eyes
qs.ex: مرحلة الـ despair: الطفل خامل ومنعزل ومكتئب وحزين.

qs.q: Which of the following child's behaviors exhibits the stage of protest in separation anxiety?
opts: Cries, screams and clings to parents
Withdrawn from others, sad and depressed
Interested in surroundings, active and communicative
Interacts with strangers and any other children
qs.ex: الـ protest: عياط وصريخ وتعلق بالأهل.

qs.q: Which of the following is a primary stressor for a child during hospitalization?
qs.ex: أهم ضغط: البعد عن الأهل والإخوات.

qs.q: A behavior observed in the despair phase of separation anxiety as a hospitalization reaction:
opts: Forms new but superficial relationships and appears happy
Regresses to earlier behavior (e.g. thumb sucking, bed wetting)
Shows increased interest in surroundings, interacts with strangers
Physically attacks strangers (kicks, bites, hits, pinches)
qs.ex: في الـ despair الطفل ممكن يرجع لتصرفات أصغر، زي مص الصباع والتبول.

qs.q: Which of the following is the period in which hospitalization reactions are obvious and risky?
qs.ex: من 6 شهور لـ 6 سنين.

qs.q: The characteristics of the despair phase of separation anxiety are:
opts: The child shows signs of interest in the surroundings
Loud cry, scream and searches for parent with eyes
qs.ex: الـ despair: اكتئاب، وتراجع، وانعزال.

qs.q: What is the appropriate nursing intervention to minimize separation anxiety in a hospitalized child?
opts: Encourage contact with children the same age
qs.ex: الأم تقعد معاه.

qs.q: A hospitalized toddler newly admitted and screams because he was left alone. The nurse realizes this behavior as typical of:
qs.ex: مرحلة الـ Protest: عياط وصريخ.

qs.q: The pediatric hospitals must offer suitable accommodations for the parents because:
opts: It is a right of hospitalized children
Parents likes to spend time side them
Rooms are plenty in the hospitals.
qs.ex: إقامة الأهل مع الطفل حق من حقوق الطفل المحجوز في المستشفى.

qs.q: Which of the following is considered more stressful for hospitalized school age children?
qs.ex: طفل سن المدرسة: فقدان السيطرة والخصوصية من أكتر الحاجات المجهدة ليه. البنك مرة تانية بيقول «البعد عن الصحاب»، فاعرف الاتنين.

qs.q: Which one of the following stressors most affect a 2-year-old toddler child?
qs.ex: أكتر حاجة بتأثر على طفل سنتين: البعد عن أهله.

qs.q: Which of the following reflects one of hospitalized child's rights?
opts: Withhold information from the child's mother
Ask mother to change her clothes into white
Discuss child condition with her friends
Accommodate the mother to stay with child
qs.ex: من حقوق الطفل المحجوز: الأم تقعد معاه.

qs.q: A hospitalized toddler, for two days, cries because he left alone. The nurse realizes this behavior is typical of:
qs.ex: مرحلة الـ Protest: عياط وصريخ.

qs.q: Hospitalized children have the right to be admitted to hospital only when their:
opts: Parents are tiered of caring for them
qs.ex: من حقوق الطفل إنه ميتحجزش في المستشفى إلا لو حالته محتاجة رعاية داخلية فعلاً.

qs.q: Which of the following is considered more stressful for hospitalized school age children?
qs.ex: طفل سن المدرسة: البعد عن صحابه وفقدان السيطرة من أكتر الحاجات المجهدة ليه. البنك فيه نسختين من السؤال بإجابتين، فاعرف الاتنين.

qs.q: A child is hospitalized for a chronic illness. Initially, the child showed symptoms of depression but later started interacting with others. What does the nurse infer from the patient's behavior? The child is:
qs.ex: مرحلة الـ Detachment.

qs.q: A 2-year-old cries loudly, clings to the mother and refuses the nurse. This is the stage of:
qs.ex: عياط بصوت عالي وتعلق بالأم ورفض الممرضة: Protest.

qs.q: Which is the major stressor for a hospitalized adolescent?
opts: Altered body image and loss of peer contact
qs.ex: المراهق: صورة الجسم والبعد عن صحابه.

qs.q: Select ALL interventions that reduce separation anxiety in a hospitalized toddler.
opts: Bring a favorite toy or blanket from home
qs.ex: علشان نقلّل قلق الانفصال: الأم تقعد معاه، ونحافظ على روتين البيت، ونجيب لعبته أو بطانيته. أما تغيير الممرضات كل شيفت أو تقليل زيارة الأهل فبيزوّدوا المشكلة.

qs.q: A child who previously cried now appears happy and interacts superficially with everyone, ignoring the parent on visits. This is:
qs.ex: بيبان مبسوط ومتعامل مع الكل بس بيتجاهل أهله: Detachment.

qs.q: Regression during hospitalization is most common among:
qs.ex: الـ Preschoolers.

qs.q: Which statement best describes the effect of loss of control on a school-age child?
opts: They fear losing control of their bodies and roles and may react with depression or hostility
qs.ex: طفل سن المدرسة بيخاف يفقد السيطرة على جسمه ودوره، وممكن يكتئب أو يبقى عدواني.

qs.q: Which of the following is the nurse's priority in the plan of care for an infant admitted with pyloric stenosis?
qs.ex: رضيع الـ pyloric stenosis بيرجّع كتير، فأول أولوية نقيّم الجفاف والأملاح قبل العملية.

qs.q: A newborn's failure to pass meconium within 24 hours after birth indicates which of the following?
qs.ex: المولود منزّلش عقي في أول 24 ساعة: نشك في imperforate anus. خلي بالك: الـ Hirschsprung كمان ممكن يعمل كده، وصورة الامتحان كاتبة إن الاتنين صح.

qs.q: When the nurse observes that the infant has respiratory distress and the apical pulse is auscultated on the right side, the nurse suspects the infant has:
qs.ex: ضيق نفس والنبض مسموع في الناحية اليمين: الأمعاء طلعت في الصدر الشمال وزقّت القلب، فده Diaphragmatic hernia.

qs.q: For an infant undergoing surgery to repair tracheo-esophageal fistula, it is essential that nursing care is directed toward prevention of:
qs.ex: أهم حاجة في رعاية الـ TEF: نمنع الـ aspiration، لأن الأكل واللعاب ممكن يروحوا للرئة.

qs.q: The position of choice postoperatively for a child with cleft palate is:
qs.ex: بعد عملية الـ cleft palate بننيّم الطفل على بطنه (prone)، علشان الإفرازات تنزل برا ومتروحش للرئة.

qs.q: A nurse is assessing a neonate with esophageal atresia. Which finding should the nurse expect to encounter?
qs.ex: الـ esophageal atresia: لعاب كتير لأنه مش لاقي سكة ينزل منها.

qs.q: A priority post-operative care for an infant with cleft lip and palate is:
opts: Protect the operative site from infection and injury
Spend good time and play with the infant
Provide a safe environment to prevent falling
qs.ex: بعد عملية الشفة والحلق: نحمي مكان الجرح من العدوى والإصابة. نستخدم Logan bow ونربط الكوع (elbow restraints).

qs.q: Preoperatively, an infant with biliary atresia must be provided with ...... formula:
qs.ex: الـ biliary atresia: الصفرا مش واصلة للأمعاء، فالفيتامينات الذائبة في الدهون مش بتتمتص، فبندّي formula فيها فيتامينات بصيغة ذائبة في الميه.

qs.q: When planning care for the infant with cleft lip and palate, the priority nursing action is:
opts: Put the child in supine position
qs.ex: نتكرّعه كتير علشان بيبلع هوا.

qs.q: The position of choice postoperatively for a child with cleft palate is:
qs.ex: بعد عملية الـ cleft palate بننيّم الطفل على بطنه (prone)، علشان الإفرازات تنزل برا ومتروحش للرئة.

qs.q: The main goal of preoperative nursing care for a newborn with esophageal atresia with tracheoesophageal fistula is:
qs.ex: قبل عملية الـ EA/TEF: نمنع الـ aspiration.

qs.q: Which of the following is expected to be found in a child with congenital diaphragmatic hernia?
opts: A palpable mass in the right upper quadrant
Scaphoid abdomen and diminished breath sounds
Severe, crampy abdominal pain and lethargy
qs.ex: الـ diaphragmatic hernia: البطن غاطسة (scaphoid) لأن الأمعاء في الصدر، والصوت التنفسي ضعيف.

qs.q: Which data does the nurse expect to find when assessing a child with pyloric stenosis?
qs.ex: الـ pyloric stenosis: ترجيع قوي (projectile).

qs.q: Which clinical manifestations would the nurse expect to observe while caring for the child diagnosed with intussusception?
qs.ex: الـ intussusception: براز زي الجيلي الأحمر.

qs.q: Which clinical manifestations would the nurse expect to assess in the child diagnosed with Hirschsprung's disease?
opts: Irritability, severe abdominal cramps and fecal soiling
Constipation and passage of ribbon-like stool
qs.ex: الـ Hirschsprung: إمساك وبراز زي الشريط.

qs.q: Preoperative care for an infant with biliary atresia includes providing formula with:
qs.ex: الـ biliary atresia: formula فيها فيتامينات water-soluble.

qs.q: A priority post-operative care for an infant with cleft lip and palate is to:
opts: Protect the operative site from infection or injury
Keep a safe environment to prevent falling
Spend good time and play with the infant
qs.ex: نحمي مكان العملية.

qs.q: Which of the following is expected to be found while assessing a child with congenital diaphragmatic hernia?
qs.ex: الصوت التنفسي ضعيف في ناحية الفتق.

qs.q: Which of the following is an important preoperative nursing intervention for a child with Hirschsprung disease?
opts: Avoid giving stool softeners or enemas
qs.ex: قبل عملية الـ Hirschsprung: نقيس محيط البطن بانتظام علشان نكشف الانتفاخ أو الـ enterocolitis.

qs.q: Which of the following is the nurse's priority in the plan of care for an infant admitted with pyloric stenosis?
qs.ex: أولوية الـ pyloric stenosis: نقيّم الجفاف.

qs.q: A priority post-operative care for an infant with cleft lip and palate is:
opts: Provides a safe environment to prevent falling
Spends good time and plays with infants
Protects operative sites from infection and injury
qs.ex: نحمي مكان العملية.

qs.q: The nurse is caring for a 4-month-old who has just had an isolated cleft lip repaired. Select the best position in the immediate post-operative period:
qs.ex: بعد عملية الشفة: على ضهره.

qs.q: The nurse monitors a newborn with a suspected diagnosis of imperforate anus. Which is a clinical manifestation associated with this disorder?
opts: The passage of currant jelly-like stools
Failure to pass meconium immediately after birth
qs.ex: الـ imperforate anus: المولود منزّلش عقي بعد الولادة.

qs.q: The nurse is reviewing the record of a child with a diagnosis of Hirschsprung disease. Which data should the nurse expect to note?
qs.ex: الـ Hirschsprung: براز رفيع زي الشريط وريحته وحشة، مع إمساك وانتفاخ.

qs.q: When the child has forceful projectile vomiting and visible gastric peristalsis, the nurse anticipates that the infant has ......
qs.ex: ترجيع قوي (projectile) ونشوف حركة المعدة من برا: Hypertrophic pyloric stenosis.

qs.q: Position of choice postoperatively to child with cleft palate is:
qs.ex: بعد عملية الـ cleft palate بننيّم الطفل على بطنه (prone)، علشان الإفرازات تنزل برا ومتروحش للرئة.

qs.q: For an infant undergoes surgery to repair tracheo-esophageal fistula, it is essential that the nursing care directed toward prevention of:
qs.ex: أهم حاجة في رعاية الـ TEF: نمنع الـ aspiration، لأن الأكل واللعاب ممكن يروحوا للرئة.

qs.q: When the nurse observes that the infant has respiratory distress and the apical pulse auscultated on the right side; the nurse suspect the infant has:
qs.ex: ضيق نفس والنبض مسموع في الناحية اليمين: الأمعاء طلعت في الصدر الشمال وزقّت القلب، فده Diaphragmatic hernia.

qs.q: The nurse is reviewing the record of a child with a diagnosis of Hirschsprung's Disease. Which data should the nurse expect to note?
qs.ex: الـ Hirschsprung: براز زي الشريط وريحته وحشة.

qs.q: A newborn's failure to pass meconium within 24 hours after birth indicate which of the following?
qs.ex: منزّلش عقي في 24 ساعة: imperforate anus (والـ Hirschsprung كمان ممكن).

qs.q: When the child has forceful projectile vomiting and visible gastric peristalsis. Based on these findings, the nurse anticipates that the infant has ......
qs.ex: ترجيع قوي (projectile) ونشوف حركة المعدة من برا: Hypertrophic pyloric stenosis.

qs.q: The nurse is caring for a 4-month-old who has just had an isolated cleft lip repaired. Select the best position for the child in the immediate post-operative period
qs.ex: بعد عملية الشفة: على ضهره.

qs.q: When planning care for the infant with cleft lip and palate, the priority nursing action is:
opts: Put the child in supine position.
qs.ex: نتكرّعه كتير علشان بيبلع هوا.

qs.q: A newborn has frothy saliva, choking and cyanosis with the first feed. The nurse suspects:
qs.ex: رغاوي لعاب وشرقة وزرقان مع أول رضعة: Esophageal atresia مع TEF.

qs.q: Preoperative positioning of an infant with EA/TEF is:
opts: Head elevated 30–40° (prone or supine) with continuous suction of the pouch
qs.ex: قبل عملية الـ EA/TEF: الراس مرفوعة 30–40° مع شفط مستمر للجيب العلوي.

qs.q: Select ALL expected findings in hypertrophic pyloric stenosis.
opts: Olive-shaped mass in the right upper quadrant
qs.ex: الـ pyloric stenosis: ترجيع قوي مش أخضر، وكتلة زي الزيتونة، وحركة المعدة باينة، وhypochloremic alkalosis. أما البراز الجيلي فده intussusception.

qs.q: After cleft lip repair, which device protects the suture line?
opts: Elbow restraints and a Logan bow
qs.ex: بعد عملية الشفة: نربط الكوع ونستخدم Logan bow.

qs.q: Which finding is typical of Hirschsprung disease in an older child?
opts: Chronic constipation with ribbon-like, foul-smelling stools and abdominal distension
qs.ex: الطفل الكبير اللي عنده Hirschsprung: إمساك مزمن، وبراز زي الشريط ريحته وحشة، وانتفاخ.

qs.q: A newborn with congenital diaphragmatic hernia is in respiratory distress. The nurse should position the infant:
opts: With head elevated and on the affected side
qs.ex: الـ diaphragmatic hernia: الراس مرفوعة، والطفل على الناحية المصابة علشان الرئة السليمة تتمدد.

qs.q: An infant whose weight falls above the 90th percentile on the intrauterine growth charts is considered large for gestational age. (True / False)
qs.ex: صح. الوزن فوق الـ percentile الـ 90 معناه LGA.

qs.q: The neonate whose birth weight is 2000 gm is considered:
qs.ex: حسب البنك: 2000 جم وزن منخفض بدرجة متوسطة (moderately low).

qs.q: Which of the following is a characteristic of prematurity?
qs.ex: المبتسر عنده شعر زغبي (lanugo) كتير.

qs.q: The nurse is caring for an infant born at 40 weeks and weighing 1800 g. What would the nurse expect in the chart?
opts: Full term, large for gestational age
Full term, small for gestational age
qs.ex: اتولد في 40 أسبوع، يعني full term، ووزنه 1800 جم، يعني قليل بالنسبة لعمره: Full term SGA.

qs.q: The nurse is teaching a mother of a newborn about developmental care. The nurse should instruct the mother to:
opts: Provide more than one stimulus at a time
Stop if there is evidence of overstimulation
Offer it during a period of sleeping
Provide it for a long period
qs.ex: في الـ developmental care: الأم توقف لو الطفل باين عليه إنه اتنبّه زيادة (overstimulation).

qs.q: The nurse observes a preterm infant with fine hair covering the forehead, back and shoulders. This finding correctly describes:
qs.ex: Lanugo.

qs.q: The best intervention to prevent infection in a high-risk neonate begins with:
opts: Not wearing a fresh scrub on care
Monitoring the mortality rate of neonates
Observing continually for signs of infection
Meticulous hand washing of all persons in contact
qs.ex: غسيل الإيد.

qs.q: The best nursing intervention to deal with a preterm neonate in the NICU:
opts: Leave the window of the incubator open
qs.ex: المبتسر في الـ NICU: نقلّل لمسه قدر الإمكان (minimal handling) علشان يوفّر طاقته.

qs.q: To prevent heat loss in high-risk neonates resulting from evaporation, the nurse should:
opts: Dry the infant in a warm towel
qs.ex: الفقد بالتبخر بنمنعه بإننا ننشّف المولود بفوطة دافية.

qs.q: Which of the following is a possible complication of prematurity?
qs.ex: من مضاعفات الولادة المبكرة: الـ RDS، بسبب نقص الـ surfactant.

qs.q: The best nursing intervention to conserve energy in a high-risk neonate is to:
qs.ex: علشان نوفّر طاقة المولود: نقلّل لمسه.

qs.q: The neonate whose birth weight is 2000 gm is considered:
qs.ex: Low birth weight.

qs.q: Which one of the following is considered a characteristic of being a preterm infant?
opts: Low-set ears that will rise later
Lack of sole creases on his feet
Scant lanugo on her back and arms
qs.ex: المبتسر مفيش في رجله خطوط (sole creases). الطالب اختار «scant lanugo» وده غلط، لأن المبتسر عنده lanugo كتير.

qs.q: Extremely low birth weight infants — their weight is:
qs.ex: الـ Extremely low birth weight: أقل من 1000 جم.

qs.q: Which of the following interventions should be included in the preterm infant's care plan?
opts: Feed dextrose water immediately after birth
qs.ex: الـ developmental care جزء من خطة رعاية المبتسر.

qs.q: The nurse should prevent heat loss in the newborn infant resulting from radiation by:
opts: Drying the infant with a warm blanket
Turning on the overhead radiant warmer
Closing the doors to the room
qs.ex: الفقد بالإشعاع (radiation) بنمنعه بإننا ندفّي الأسطح اللي حوالين الطفل بالـ radiant warmer.

qs.q: The best intervention to prevent infection in high-risk neonate begins with:
opts: Not wearing a fresh scrub on care.
Observing continually for signs of infection.
Meticulous hand washing of all persons in contact.
qs.ex: غسيل الإيد.

qs.q: Which of the following is characteristics of prematurity?
qs.ex: المبتسر عنده شعر زغبي (lanugo) كتير.

qs.q: The nurse assisted with the delivery of a newborn. Which nursing action is most effective in preventing heat loss by evaporation?
opts: Closing the doors to the room
Drying the infant with a warm blanket,
Turning on the overhead radiant warmer
qs.ex: الفقد بالتبخر: ننشّفه ببطانية دافية.

qs.q: An infant whose weight falls above the 90th. percentile on the intrauterine growth charts considered large for gestational age
qs.ex: صح. فوق الـ percentile الـ 90 يبقى LGA.

qs.q: The nurse should prevent the heat loss in the new born infant resulting from radlation by:
opts: Closing the doors to the room
Turning on the overhead radiant warmer
Drying the infant with a warm blanket
qs.ex: الفقد بالإشعاع (radiation) بنمنعه بإننا ندفّي الأسطح اللي حوالين الطفل بالـ radiant warmer.

qs.q: Which of the following is a possible complication of prematurity?
qs.ex: من مضاعفات الولادة المبكرة: الـ RDS، بسبب نقص الـ surfactant.

qs.q: The nurse caring for an infant born at 40 weeks and weighing 1800g. What statement would nurse expect in chart
opts: Preterm a small for gestational age.
A full term a large for gestational age.
A preterm a large for gestational age.
A full term a small for gestational age.
qs.ex: Full term وSGA.

qs.q: The nurse observes a preterm infants with fine hair covered the forehead, back and shoulders. This finding correctly describes:
qs.ex: Lanugo.

qs.q: The neonate infant whose birth weight is 2000 gm is considered:
qs.ex: Low birth weight.

qs.q: To prevent heat loss in the high risk neonates resulting from evaporation the nurse should...
opts: Dry the infant in a warm towel
qs.ex: الفقد بالتبخر بنمنعه بإننا ننشّف المولود بفوطة دافية.

qs.q: A neonate born at 39 weeks weighs 2100 g. The correct classification is:
qs.ex: 39 أسبوع يعني term، و2100 جم: Term SGA (low birth weight).

qs.q: Which finding is characteristic of a preterm infant?
opts: Abundant lanugo and few sole creases
qs.ex: المبتسر: lanugo كتير وخطوط قليلة في رجله.

qs.q: Select ALL physiological handicaps of the premature infant.
qs.ex: مشاكل المبتسر: ضعف تنظيم الحرارة، ومشاكل في التنفس وapnea، وقابلية للعدوى، وكبد مش ناضج. أما «مناعة قوية من الأم» فغلط.

qs.q: To prevent heat loss by CONVECTION the nurse should:
opts: Keep the baby away from drafts and keep incubator portholes closed
Place the baby under a radiant warmer
qs.ex: الـ convection: نبعّده عن تيارات الهوا ونقفل فتحات الحضانة.

qs.q: Very low birth weight (VLBW) refers to a birth weight of:
qs.ex: الـ VLBW: أقل من 1500 جم.

qs.q: Developmental care in the NICU includes:
opts: Clustering care, minimal handling and reducing noise
qs.ex: الـ developmental care: نجمع الرعاية مع بعض، ونقلّل اللمس، ونقلّل الدوشة.

qs.q: The nurse is observing children playing in the hospital playroom. She would expect to see 4-year-old children playing:
opts: With their own toys alongside other children
Competitive board games with older children
qs.ex: طفل 4 سنين بيلعب لعب تمثيلي (pretend) مع أطفال تانيين.

qs.q: The nurse develops a plan of care including play activities. How does play benefit children?
opts: It helps to improve their physical development
It develops only their normal mental abilities
qs.ex: اللعب بيساعد على النمو الجسدي.

qs.q: (Matching) Play beside, but not with, each other is called:
qs.ex: الـ Parallel play: الأطفال بيلعبوا جنب بعض، بس كل واحد لوحده من غير تفاعل. ده مميز للـ toddler.

qs.q: (Matching) A form of mental play is:
qs.ex: الـ Day dreaming (أحلام اليقظة) نوع من اللعب العقلي.

qs.q: (Matching) Play with own body parts is:
qs.ex: الرضيع بيلعب بأجزاء جسمه وهو لوحده: Solitary. ده كان سؤال توصيل وإجابته من ورقة الطالب.

qs.q: When children start to interact with others during play it is called parallel play. (True / False)
qs.ex: غلط. لما الأطفال يبدأوا يتفاعلوا في اللعب يبقى associative أو cooperative، مش parallel.

qs.q: A 2-year-old child likes to play:
opts: Beside other children, but not with them
With other children and borrow and loan toys
In groups and share games with each other
qs.ex: طفل سنتين بيلعب جنب الأطفال مش معاهم (parallel).

qs.q: The pediatric nurse should consider, when selecting a toy for a hospitalized child, that it is:
qs.ex: اللعبة لازم تبقى مناسبة لسن الطفل وحالته الصحية.

qs.q: In which type of play do children play beside one another, but not with each other?
qs.ex: Parallel play: جنب بعض من غير تفاعل.

qs.q: While selecting a toy for a hospitalized child, the pediatric nurse considers that the toy should be:
qs.ex: مناسبة للسن والحالة الصحية.

qs.q: You're developing a plan of care for a 4-year-old that includes play activities. What type will he participate in at this age?
qs.ex: الـ Sociodramatic play: لعب الأدوار (دكتور، أم، ظابط). ده مميز للـ preschool.

qs.q: The nurse develops a plan of care including play activities. How does play benefit children?
opts: It develops only their normal mental capacity
It helps to improve their physical growth
qs.ex: اللعب بيحسّن النمو الجسدي.

qs.q: How does play benefit children? It ......
opts: Develops only their normal mental capacity
Helps to improve their physical growth
qs.ex: اللعب بيحسّن النمو الجسدي.

qs.q: Play for the hospitalized child is necessary to ......
qs.ex: اللعب في المستشفى بيفرّغ التوتر.

qs.q: The benefit of play for the hospitalized child is:
qs.ex: بيدّي تسلية واسترخاء.

qs.q: At which age group does the child start to interact with others during play?
qs.ex: الطفل بيبدأ يتفاعل مع غيره في اللعب في سن الـ Preschool.

qs.q: What is the main characteristic of parallel play?
opts: Playing together in a shared activity
qs.ex: الـ parallel: بيلعب جنب أطفال تانيين.

qs.q: When children sit in a group but each one plays alone, this type of play is:
qs.ex: الـ Parallel play: الأطفال بيلعبوا جنب بعض، بس كل واحد لوحده من غير تفاعل. ده مميز للـ toddler.

qs.q: The nurse is observing a four-year-old child playing in the hospital playroom. Which of the following would she expect to see?
opts: Competitive board games with older children
With their own toys alongside other children
qs.ex: طفل 4 سنين: لعب تمثيلي مع أطفال تانيين.

qs.q: As the nurse in charge prepares a playroom for ill children in a pediatric hospital, which play value should the selected toys mostly reflect?
qs.ex: اللعب العلاجي (therapeutic)، زي الصفارة لطفل عنده إفرازات في الصدر، بيساعده يتنفس ويطلّعها.

qs.q: A mother tells the nurse that her preschool girl's toy is an empty box with a stove in it and she calls it "the house". Based on this information, this child's play type is:
qs.ex: لعب «البيت» ده Socio-dramatic play.

qs.q: In which type of play would you see children playing with puzzles alongside, but with no actual sharing?
qs.ex: الـ Parallel play: الأطفال بيلعبوا جنب بعض، بس كل واحد لوحده من غير تفاعل. ده مميز للـ toddler.

qs.q: The type of play that allows children to try out a variety of roles, such as husband, wife, doctor, or police officer:
qs.ex: الـ Sociodramatic play: لعب الأدوار (دكتور، أم، ظابط). ده مميز للـ preschool.

qs.q: Choosing a suitable child's toy is influenced by the child's culture. (True / False)
qs.ex: صح. ثقافة الطفل بتأثر على اختيار لعبته.

qs.q: When a nurse gives a toddler with secretions in the lung a whistle, this will fulfill which play value?
qs.ex: اللعب العلاجي (therapeutic)، زي الصفارة لطفل عنده إفرازات في الصدر، بيساعده يتنفس ويطلّعها.

qs.q: Which of the following examples represents parallel play?
opts: Heba plays with a rattle while sitting on her mother's lap
Ahmed plays with a car beside Heba, who plays with a doll
Ahmed and Aly share their toys
Ahmed plays a game with Aly and Hany
qs.ex: أحمد بيلعب بعربية جنب هبة اللي بتلعب بعروسة: ده parallel.

qs.q: When caregivers choose a toy for their children, they must consider that the ......
opts: Toy is suitable to developmental age
qs.ex: اللعبة لازم تبقى مناسبة لسن الطفل التطوري.

qs.q: Children are playing with toys, but they are not playing together. This type of play is known as:
qs.ex: الـ Parallel play: الأطفال بيلعبوا جنب بعض، بس كل واحد لوحده من غير تفاعل. ده مميز للـ toddler.

qs.q: Constructive play is the type of play for preschool children. (True / False)
qs.ex: غلط. الـ Constructive play خاص بسن المدرسة، مش الـ preschool.

qs.q: A 3-year-old plays with blocks beside another child who plays with cars, without interacting. This is:
qs.ex: بيلعب بالمكعبات جنب طفل تاني من غير تفاعل: Parallel.

qs.q: Which play activity is most suitable for a 4-year-old?
qs.ex: طفل 4 سنين: لعب تمثيلي زي «دكتور».

qs.q: Select ALL functions of play in the hospital.
opts: Helps the child feel more secure
qs.ex: اللعب في المستشفى: بيسلّي، وبيخلي الطفل يحس بالأمان، وبيقلّل قلق الانفصال، وبيعبّر بيه عن مشاعره. ومش بيزوّد الخوف.

qs.q: Blowing bubbles or a whistle for a child with lung secretions is an example of which play value?
qs.ex: النفخ في الفقاعات أو الصفارة: Therapeutic.

qs.q: Which toy is safest for an 8-month-old?
opts: Large soft blocks with no detachable parts
qs.ex: رضيع 8 شهور: مكعبات كبيرة طرية ومفيهاش أجزاء بتتفك.

qs.q: Constructive play is typical of:
qs.ex: الـ Constructive play: سن المدرسة.

qs.q: Toddlers are more prone to accidents because of their:
qs.ex: الـ toddler فضولي وبيتحرك كتير ومش واخد باله من الخطر، علشان كده بيتعرض لحوادث أكتر.

qs.q: When the mother keeps all medicines and household products out of the reach of children, this represents:
qs.ex: إن الأم تشيل الأدوية والمنظفات بعيد عن إيد الطفل: Active preventive strategy، لأن ده سلوك بتعمله هي.

qs.q: The common site of accidental injuries in children under the age of 15 years is:
qs.ex: أشهر مكان لحوادث الأطفال تحت 15 سنة: البيت.

qs.q: Which of the following is the most common injury in infants?
qs.ex: أشهر إصابة في الرضع: الاختناق (suffocation).

qs.q: The incidence of injuries among 2–6-year-old children in Egypt is as follows:
qs.ex: الإصابات عند الولاد أكتر من البنات.

qs.q: Which one of the following is considered the most common cause of injuries among rural children?
qs.ex: أشهر سبب إصابة في أطفال الريف: الغرق (الترع).

qs.q: The most common indoor accident among 6-month-old infants is:
qs.ex: أشهر حادثة جوه البيت لرضيع 6 شهور: الوقوع (falling).

qs.q: Which of the following measures should be followed at home to ensure child safety?
opts: Medicines are to be kept on the dinner table
Electrical plugs must be covered and at low level
Kitchen curtains are better to be used than doors
Furniture is to be away from the window
qs.ex: من أمان البيت: العفش يبقى بعيد عن الشبابيك علشان الطفل ميطلعش عليه ويقع.

qs.q: When the mother keeps all medicines and household products out of the reach from children, this represents
qs.ex: إن الأم تشيل الأدوية والمنظفات بعيد عن إيد الطفل: Active preventive strategy، لأن ده سلوك بتعمله هي.

qs.q: Which patients are most at risk for sudden infant death syndrome? (Select all that apply)
opts: A newborn whose mother had 1 drink of alcohol early in pregnancy
A 2-month-old infant who sleeps in the bed with his mother
A 1-month-old infant who prefers to sleep on his stomach
A 1-month-old infant who prefers to sleep on her back
A newborn whose mother smokes 2 packs/day
qs.ex: الأكثر عرضة للـ SIDS: الرضيع اللي بينام مع أمه في السرير، واللي بينام على بطنه، واللي أمه بتدخن.

qs.q: What is the leading cause of death in children older than 1 year?
qs.ex: أول سبب وفاة بعد سنة: الإصابات غير المقصودة (الحوادث).

qs.q: What should the nurse teach parents of a toddler about prevention of accidental poisoning? (Select all that apply)
opts: Keep toxic substances in the garage
Remove colorful labels from containers of toxic materials
Know the number of the nearest poison control center
Caution the child against eating nonedible items such as plants
qs.ex: الوقاية من التسمم: نعرف رقم مركز السموم، ونحذّر الطفل ياكل حاجات مش أكل زي النباتات، ونرمي العلب الفاضية. التخزين في الجراج مش آمن، وشيل الـ labels غلط.

qs.q: Which groups of infants have a higher risk for SIDS? (Select all that apply)
qs.ex: خطر الـ SIDS أعلى في: الذكور، والـ Apgar الواطي، والوزن القليل.

qs.q: For what injuries are crawling infants most at risk?
qs.ex: الرضيع اللي بيزحف بيحط أي حاجة في بقه، فهو معرّض للـ aspiration والتسمم.

qs.q: Which statement is true regarding injury prevention in infants and toddlers?
opts: Repeated "No" is needed to be effective with this age group.
Injury prevention and parent education should be handled on a growth and developmental basis.
Falls are the most common injuries for these age groups.
All injuries can be prevented with proper education regarding safety measures.
qs.ex: الوقاية من الحوادث وتعليم الأهل بيتعملوا حسب مرحلة نمو الطفل.

qs.q: The most common indoor accident among 6-month-old infants is:
qs.ex: أشهر حادثة جوه البيت لرضيع 6 شهور: الوقوع (falling).

qs.q: Which of the following measures should at home to ensure child safety?
opts: Medicines are to be kept on dinner table
Electrical plugs must be covered and at low level
Kitchen curtains are better to be used than doors
Furnitures are to be away from the window
qs.ex: العفش بعيد عن الشباك.

qs.q: The incidence of injuries among 2 – 6 years old children at Egypt is as following
qs.ex: الإصابات عند الولاد أكتر من البنات.

qs.q: A mother of a 9-month-old asks which injury her crawling infant is most at risk for. The nurse answers:
opts: Motor vehicle injury as a pedestrian
Aspiration of small objects and poisoning
qs.ex: الرضيع اللي بيزحف: معرّض يشفط حاجات صغيرة ويتسمم.

qs.q: Which is an example of an ACTIVE (behavioral) preventive strategy?
opts: Child-resistant medicine caps made by the factory
Parent stores medicines and cleaners in a locked high cabinet
qs.ex: الاستراتيجية الإيجابية (active): الأهل يحطوا الأدوية في دولاب عالي مقفول.

qs.q: Select ALL teaching points that reduce the risk of SIDS.
opts: Place the infant on the back to sleep
Use a firm mattress without pillows or soft toys
qs.ex: الوقاية من الـ SIDS: الطفل ينام على ضهره، على مرتبة ناشفة من غير مخدات، ومحدش يدخن جنبه. أما النوم مع الأهل والتلبيس الكتير فبيزوّدوا الخطر.

qs.q: Why are toddlers especially prone to accidents?
opts: Curiosity and increasing mobility with poor awareness of danger
qs.ex: الـ toddler فضولي وبيتحرك ومش واخد باله من الخطر.

qs.q: In the epidemiological model of injury, a hot cup of tea that scalds a toddler represents the:
qs.ex: كوباية الشاي السخنة هي الـ Agent (الحاجة اللي عملت الإصابة).

qs.q: Which statement about injuries among Egyptian children is correct?
opts: Girls have more injuries than boys
Drowning and animal bites occur mainly among rural children
Burns are the least common injury
qs.ex: الغرق وعضّ الحيوانات أكتر في أطفال الريف.

qs.q: The nurse plans to instruct the mother about measures to prevent breast engorgement. The nurse should tell her to:
opts: Wear a supportive brassiere with nipple shields
Restrict fluid intake for 24 to 48 hours
Feed the neonate for only 5 minutes per side on the first day
qs.ex: علشان نمنع احتقان الثدي: الأم ترضّع كتير.

qs.q: A new mother asks why she should feed her newborn colostrum. The nurse's most appropriate answer is because it is:
opts: Helping the mother learn how to breastfeed before she goes home
High in antibodies, protein, vitamins, and minerals
Lower in calories than milk and should be supplemented by formula
qs.ex: السرسوب (colostrum) فيه أجسام مضادة وبروتين وفيتامينات ومعادن كتير.

qs.q: The nurse should instruct the mother that colostrum provides the neonate with:
opts: More fats than breast milk has
Required vitamin K for the neonate
Iron needed till age of 6 months
qs.ex: السرسوب بيدّي المولود أجسام مضادة هو مش عنده.

qs.q: Which of the following statements is correct when teaching a mother about breastfeeding?
opts: Initiate breastfeeding within 4 hours after birth
Give only breast milk for the first 6 months of age
Allow artificial teats or pacifiers to breastfed infants
qs.ex: رضاعة طبيعية بس أول 6 شهور.

qs.q: A new mother asks whether she should feed her newborn colostrum. The nurse's most appropriate answer is:
opts: Colostrum is high in antibodies, protein, vitamins, and minerals
Colostrum is lower in calories than milk and should be supplemented by formula
Colostrum is important as it is rich in iron
qs.ex: السرسوب غني بالأجسام المضادة والبروتين.

qs.q: The nurse plans to instruct the mother about the measures to prevent breast engorgement:
opts: Wear a supportive brassiere with nipple shields
Administer fluid intake for 24 to 48 hours
Feed the neonate for only 5 minutes per side on the first day
qs.ex: علشان نمنع احتقان الثدي: الأم ترضّع كتير.

qs.q: The indicators of successful breastfeeding include the following EXCEPT:
qs.ex: علامات نجاح الرضاعة: الطفل بيبلّ ويعمل براز كويس، ووزنه بيزيد، ونومه هادي. أما العرق الكتير فمش منها.

qs.q: Which of the following statements is most relevant to exclusive breastfeeding?
opts: Early initiation and for six months
For six months at daytime only
qs.ex: الرضاعة الطبيعية الحصرية: تبدأ بدري وتكمل 6 شهور.

qs.q: To ensure successful breastfeeding the child must:
opts: Latch on well to the breast
qs.ex: علشان الرضاعة تنجح: الطفل يمسك الثدي صح (latch on).

qs.q: A mother asks why her baby should get colostrum. The best answer is that colostrum is:
opts: Lower in protein than mature milk
Rich in antibodies (IgA) and acts as the baby's first immunization
Mainly water and has no nutritional value
High in fat to help weight gain
qs.ex: السرسوب غني بالأجسام المضادة (IgA)، وبيعتبر أول تطعيم للطفل.

qs.q: Which hormone is responsible for the milk let-down (ejection) reflex?
qs.ex: الـ Oxytocin مسؤول عن نزول اللبن.

qs.q: Select ALL signs that a breastfed infant is receiving enough milk.
opts: 6 or more wet diapers per day
qs.ex: علامات إن الطفل بياخد كفايته: 6 حفاضات مبلولة أو أكتر، ووزن بيزيد، ونوم هادي بعد الرضعة.

qs.q: Which nutrient is NOT sufficient in breast milk and should be supplemented?
qs.ex: لبن الأم فيتامين D فيه مش كفاية، فبنكمّله.

qs.q: According to WHO/UNICEF, breastfeeding should be initiated:
qs.ex: الرضاعة تبدأ في أول ساعة بعد الولادة.

qs.q: Complementary feeding should start at:
qs.ex: الأكل التكميلي يبدأ في 6 شهور مع استمرار الرضاعة.

qs.q: Khalid is a 3-day-old infant admitted to the pediatric surgical ward with a myelomeningocele and hydrocephalus. While caring for Khalid the nurse should:
opts: Assist with the insertion of a central line
Position him on the right side
Cover the sac with a moist and sterile dressing
qs.ex: الـ myelomeningocele قبل العملية: نغطّي الكيس بشاش معقم مبلول بمحلول ملح علشان ميتشقش وميتلوثش.

qs.q: Khalid is a 3-day-old infant admitted with a myelomeningocele and hydrocephalus. The recommended position for Khalid is:
qs.ex: الـ myelomeningocele: ننيّم الطفل على بطنه (prone) علشان منضغطش على الكيس.

qs.q: (Matching) Anencephaly is best described as:
opts: Incomplete fusion of the vertebrae that may be signaled by an overlying tuft of hair
A protrusion of nerve tissue and meninges through a skull defect
A sac of meninges and CSF protruding through a vertebral defect without nerve tissue
qs.ex: الـ Anencephaly: غياب نصفي المخ.

qs.q: (Matching) Encephalocele is best described as:
opts: Incomplete fusion of the vertebrae that may be signaled by an overlying tuft of hair
A protrusion of nerve tissue and meninges through a skull defect
A sac of meninges and CSF protruding through a vertebral defect without nerve tissue
qs.ex: الـ Encephalocele: نسيج عصبي وأغشية طالعين من فتحة في الجمجمة.

qs.q: (Matching) Spina bifida occulta is best described as:
opts: Incomplete fusion of the vertebrae that may be signaled by an overlying tuft of hair
A protrusion of nerve tissue and meninges through a skull defect
A sac of meninges and CSF protruding through a vertebral defect without nerve tissue
qs.ex: الـ Spina bifida occulta: الفقرات مقفلتش، وممكن يبان عليها خصلة شعر.

qs.q: (Matching) Meningocele is best described as:
opts: Incomplete fusion of the vertebrae that may be signaled by an overlying tuft of hair
A protrusion of nerve tissue and meninges through a skull defect
A sac of meninges and CSF protruding through a vertebral defect without nerve tissue
qs.ex: الـ Meningocele: كيس فيه أغشية وCSF بس، من غير أعصاب.

qs.q: When caring for an infant with spina bifida, which technique is most important in recognizing possible hydrocephalus?
qs.ex: طفل الـ spina bifida معرّض للـ hydrocephalus، فبنقيس محيط الراس يومياً.

qs.q: The nurse informed doctors that the WBC in CSF culture is up to 1000 and the CSF is turbid for a child with a VP shunt. What is the nurse's interpretation?
opts: Normal WBC and color of CSF
qs.ex: كرات بيضا عالية وCSF عكر مع الـ shunt: فيه عدوى في الـ CSF.

qs.q: The major cause of congenital hydrocephalus is brain tumor. (True / False)
qs.ex: غلط. أشهر سبب للـ hydrocephalus الخلقي هو ضيق قناة الـ aqueduct.

qs.q: What is the major cause of congenital hydrocephalus that interrupts ventricular circulation in the brain?
qs.ex: الـ Aqueduct stenosis.

qs.q: The nurse informed doctors that the WBC in CSF culture is up to 1000 for a child connected to a VP shunt. What is the nurse's interpretation?
qs.ex: الـ WBC العالي في الـ CSF معناه عدوى.

qs.q: The most important preoperative nursing action for a child with myelomeningocele is:
opts: Diapering and sponge bath for the child
Apply a sterile, moist, non-adherent dressing
Keep the infant in the prone position
qs.ex: قبل العملية: شاش معقم مبلول مش لاصق على الكيس.

qs.q: Which of the following nursing actions is most important in caring for a child with hydrocephalus?
qs.ex: نقيس محيط الراس علشان نكشف الـ hydrocephalus.

qs.q: One of the following is the most important nursing intervention for an infant born with spina bifida cystica:
opts: Provide psychological support to the family
Cover the defect with a saline-soaked dressing
qs.ex: الـ spina bifida cystica: نغطّي العيب بشاش مبلول بمحلول ملح.

qs.q: Postoperative nursing care of a child after insertion of a ventriculoperitoneal shunt is ......
opts: Check the urine for glucose and protein
qs.ex: بعد الـ VP shunt: نراقب الحرارة، احتمال عدوى.

qs.q: When caring for an infant with spina bifida, which measure is most important in recognizing possible hydrocephalus?
qs.ex: نقيس محيط الراس علشان نكشف الـ hydrocephalus.

qs.q: Which priority intervention should the nurse perform for the child's position after insertion of a shunt to relieve hydrocephalus?
qs.ex: بعد الـ shunt: الطفل ينام على الناحية اللي مفيهاش عملية.

qs.q: Khalid is a 3-day-old infant admitted with a myelomeningocele and hydrocephalus. While caring for Khalid the nurse should:
opts: Assist with the insertion of a central line
Position him on the right side
Cover the sac with a moist and sterile dressing
qs.ex: الـ myelomeningocele قبل العملية: نغطّي الكيس بشاش معقم مبلول بمحلول ملح علشان ميتشقش وميتلوثش.

qs.q: The most common complication for VP shunt is:
qs.ex: أشهر مضاعفة للـ VP shunt: الانسداد (obstruction).

qs.q: An infant is born with a sac protruding through the spine, containing CSF, a portion of meninges and nerve roots. the condition is referred to as
qs.ex: كيس فيه CSF وأغشية وأعصاب: Myelomeningocele.

qs.q: The nurse is caring for an infant with a myelomeningocele. the parents ask the nurse why they keep measuring the babys head circumference. select the nurses best response
opts: Babies heads are measured to ensure growth is on track
Babies with a myelomeningocele are at risk for hydrocephalus, which shows up as an increase in head size
Because your baby has an opening on the spinal cord, your infant is at risk for meningitis, which can show up as an increase in head size
Many infants with myelomeningocele have microcephaly, which can show up as a decrease in head size
qs.ex: أطفال الـ myelomeningocele معرّضين للـ hydrocephalus، وده بيبان في زيادة حجم الراس.

qs.q: A parent of a newborn diagnosed with myelomeningocele asks what is a common long term complication. the nurses best response is
qs.ex: حسب البنك: من أشهر المضاعفات على المدى الطويل الـ UTI، بسبب مشاكل المثانة العصبية.

qs.q: Which would be included in the plan of care for a hospitalized newborn following surgical repair of a myelomeningocele? (Select all that apply)
qs.ex: بعد عملية الـ myelomeningocele: نقيس محيط الراس يومياً، ونعمل MRI.

qs.q: Which is included in the plan of care for a newborn who has myelomeningocele
opts: Place the child in the prone position with a sterile dry dressing over the defect. slowly begin oral gastric feeds to prevent the development of nectrozing enterocolitis
Place the child in the prone position with a sterile dry dressing over the defect. begin IV fluids to prevent dehydration
Place the child in the prone position with a sterile moist dressing over the defect. slowly begin oral gastric feeds to prevent the development of necrotizing enterocolitis
Place the child in the prone position with a sterile moist dressing over the defect. begin IV fluids to prevent dehydrations
qs.ex: قبل العملية: على بطنه، وشاش معقم مبلول على العيب، ونبدأ IV fluids.

qs.q: Which does the nurse include in the postoperative plan of care of a child with myelomeningocele following ligament release?
opts: Encourage resuming a regular diet, beginning slowly with bland foods such as bananas
Encourage the child to blow balloons to increase deep breathing
Assist the child to change positions to avoid skin breakdown
Provide education on dietary requirements to prevent obesity and skin breakdown
qs.ex: بعد العملية: نغيّر وضعه علشان الجلد ميتقرحش.

qs.q: The nurse is working in a school health clinic and a teen mentions that her older sister just had a baby born with a myelomeningocele. the teen is wondering if there is anything she can do to prevent this from happening to her baby when she decides to have children. which is the best response
opts: Take a multivtaim with folic acid daily
Eat more fruits and vegetables daily
There is nothing that can be done to decrease the risk
qs.ex: حمض الفوليك (folic acid) يومياً قبل الحمل بيقلّل عيوب الأنبوب العصبي.

qs.q: The nurse is caring for an infant with myelomeningocele who is going to surgery later today for closure of the sac. which would be a priority nursing diagnosis before surgery
qs.ex: قبل العملية: أهم تشخيص Risk of infection.

qs.q: Which should be included in the plan of care for a newborn with myelomeningocele who will have a surgical repair tomorrow
opts: Turn the infant back to front every 2 hours
Place a wet dressing on the sac
qs.ex: قبل العملية: شاش مبلول على الكيس.

qs.q: Which should the nurse do first when caring for an infant who just had a repair of a myelomeningocele
opts: Weight diapers for 24 hour urine output
qs.ex: أول حاجة بعد العملية: نقيس محيط الراس.

qs.q: Which should be the priority ND for a 12 hour old newborn with a myelomeningocele at L2
opts: Altered bowel elimination r/t neuro deficits
Potential for infection r/t the physical defect
Disturbance in self concept r/t physical disability
qs.ex: الأولوية: خطر العدوى بسبب العيب المفتوح.

qs.q: Over the last week an infant with repiared myelomeningocele has had a high pitched cry and been irritable. length, weight and head circumference have been at the 50th percentile. today length is at the 50th percentile, weight is at the 70th percentile and head circumference is at the 90th percentile. the nurse should do which of the following
opts: Tell the parent this is normal for an infant with a repaired myelomeningocele
Tell the parent this might mean the baby has increased icp
Suspect the baby's icp is low because of a leak
Refer the baby to the nuerologist for follow up care
