qs.q: Which should the nurse prepare the parents of an infant for the following surgical repair and closure of a myelomeningocele shortly after birth. the infant will:
opts: Not need any long term management and should be considered cured
Not bo at risk for UTI or movement problems
Have continual drainage of CSF needed frequent dressing changes
Need lifelong management of urinary, orthopedic and neurological problems
qs.ex: الطفل هيحتاج متابعة طول عمره لمشاكل المثانة والعضم والأعصاب.

qs.q: A newborn with a repaired myelomeningocele is assessed for hydrocephalus. which would the nurse expect in an infant with hydrocephalus
opts: Low pitched cry and depressed fontanel
Low pitched cry and bulging fontanel
Bulging fontanel and downwardly rotated eyes
Depressed fontanel and upwardly rotated eyes
qs.ex: الـ Hydrocephalus: يافوخ منفوخ، والعيون بتبص لتحت (sunset eyes).

qs.q: A nurse is caring for a neonate born 12 hours ago with a myelomeningocele. Which assessment finding should be reported immediately to the PCP
qs.ex: حرارة 39 (102.2 F) لازم تتبلّغ فوراً، احتمال عدوى أو meningitis.

qs.q: An infant has returned to the peds unit after repair of a meylomeningocele. The nruse notices that the infant has had no urine output in the past 2 hours. Which nursing intervention would be most appropriate
opts: Perform credes maneuver on the infants bladder
Ask the mother to breast feed the infant
qs.ex: مفيش بول بقاله ساعتين بعد العملية: المثانة العصبية ممكن تكون محتبسة، فنعمل قسطرة.

qs.q: The parents of a child newly dx with myelomeningocele ask the nurse why surgical repair needs to be done immediately. Which reponse would be most accurate
opts: Its done to rapidly restore neural pathways to the legs
Its done to decrease the possibility of infection and further cord damage
Its done to expose the spinal cord defect and allow an individualized therapeutic strategy
Its done to remove excess nerve tissue from the vertebral canal and to decrease pressure on the cord
qs.ex: العملية بتتعمل بدري علشان نقلّل العدوى وأي ضرر زيادة في النخاع.

qs.q: The most important pre-operative nursing action for child with myelomeningocele is:
opts: Diapering and sponged path for the child
Keep infant in the prone position
qs.ex: قبل العملية: شاش معقم مبلول مش لاصق على الكيس.

qs.q: The nurse is working in the PICU caring for an infant who has just returned from having a shunt placed for hydrocephalus. Which position initially will be most beneficial for this child?
opts: In crib with HOB elevated 90 degrees
qs.ex: بعد الـ shunt على طول: الطفل يتحط flat علشان الـ CSF مايتسحبش بسرعة زيادة.

qs.q: Early signs and symptoms of hydrocephalus in an infant include which of the following?
opts: Rapid head growth, poor feeding, confusion
Full fontanels, poor feeding, rapid head growth
qs.ex: علامات الـ hydrocephalus بدري: يافوخ منفوخ، ورضاعة ضعيفة، وراس بتكبر بسرعة.

qs.q: Which of the following nursing action is most important in caring of child with hydrocephalus?
qs.ex: نقيس محيط الراس علشان نكشف الـ hydrocephalus.

qs.q: The nurse informed doctors about the WBC result in CSF culture up to 1000 for child connected with VP shunt, what the nurse interpretation of this result
qs.ex: الـ WBC العالي في الـ CSF معناه عدوى.

qs.q: Khalid is 3 days old infant admitted to the pediatric surgical ward with a myelomeningocele and hydrocephalus while caring for Khalid the nurse should
opts: Assist with the insertion of a central line
Position him on the right side
Cover sac with a moist and sterile dressing
qs.ex: نغطّي الكيس بشاش معقم مبلول.

qs.q: Khalid is 3 days old infant admitted to the pediatric surgical ward with a myelomeningocele and hydrocephalus the recommended position for Khalid is
qs.ex: الـ myelomeningocele: على بطنه (prone) علشان منضغطش على الكيس.

qs.q: What is the major cause for congenital hydrocephalus that interrupted ventricle circulation in the brain?
qs.ex: أشهر سبب للـ hydrocephalus الخلقي: ضيق الـ aqueduct.

qs.q: The priority preoperative care for a newborn with myelomeningocele is:
opts: Covering the sac with a sterile, moist, non-adherent dressing
Allowing the parents to hold the baby upright
qs.ex: قبل العملية: نغطّي الكيس بشاش معقم مبلول مش لاصق.

qs.q: Which is an early sign of hydrocephalus in an infant?
opts: Rapidly increasing head circumference with bulging fontanel
qs.ex: علامة بدرية: محيط الراس بيزيد بسرعة واليافوخ منفوخ.

qs.q: Select ALL signs of VP shunt malfunction or infection.
qs.ex: علامات إن الـ shunt مش شغال أو فيه عدوى: ترجيع وعصبية، ويافوخ منفوخ، وحرارة، وعياط حاد. الشهية الزيادة مش منهم.

qs.q: Which advice helps prevent neural tube defects?
opts: Folic acid 0.4 mg daily before conception and in early pregnancy
qs.ex: حمض الفوليك 0.4 مجم يومياً قبل الحمل وفي أوله.

qs.q: Spina bifida occulta is often signaled by:
opts: A large sac on the back
A tuft of hair or dimple over the lumbosacral spine
qs.ex: الـ spina bifida occulta: خصلة شعر أو نُقرة على أسفل الضهر.

qs.q: Immediately after VP shunt insertion, the infant is usually positioned:
qs.ex: بعد الـ shunt: flat على الناحية اللي مفيهاش عملية.

qs.q: Which of the following nursing diagnoses is most appropriate for a child with rheumatic fever?
qs.ex: طفل الـ rheumatic fever: High risk for injury، بسبب الـ chorea ووجع المفاصل.

qs.q: A nurse is preparing a child for discharge after being diagnosed with rheumatic fever. Which is the correct instruction?
opts: Only give penicillin for dental work
Give aspirin for management of chorea
Give penicillin for one month total
qs.ex: تعليمات الخروج: الـ penicillin يستمر لحد سن 21.

qs.q: Which of the following instructions would the nurse include in a teaching plan that focuses on prevention of rheumatic fever?
opts: Give penicillin to patients for treatment
Seek immediate treatment for throat infection
qs.ex: الوقاية: أي التهاب في الزور يتعالج فوراً. الـ corticosteroid اللي الطالب اختاره علاج مش وقاية.

qs.q: One minor manifestation of rheumatic fever is:
qs.ex: الـ minor: زيادة الـ ESR.

qs.q: Symptoms of rheumatic fever typically appear how long after a streptococcal infection?
qs.ex: الأعراض بتظهر بعد التهاب الزور بـ 2–3 أسابيع.

qs.q: Which joints are most commonly affected by pain or swelling in rheumatic fever?
qs.ex: المفاصل الكبيرة: الركبة، والكاحل، والكوع، والرسغ.

qs.q: What type of joint pain is often seen in rheumatic fever?
opts: Pain that moves from joint to joint (migratory)
qs.ex: وجع المفاصل بيتنقل من مفصل لمفصل (migratory).

qs.q: Which is NOT a typical manifestation of rheumatic fever?
qs.ex: الـ Headache مش من علاماتها.

qs.q: Under the 2015 Modified Jones Criteria, which symptom most likely indicates rheumatic fever?
qs.ex: مفاصل سخنة أو بتوجع.

qs.q: Which body systems are typically affected in rheumatic fever?
qs.ex: العضلات والمفاصل، والقلب، والجهاز العصبي.

qs.q: Under the 2015 Modified Jones Criteria, which is a common sign?
qs.ex: حرارة ووجع مفاصل.

qs.q: Which is the characteristic skin manifestation of rheumatic fever?
qs.ex: الـ Erythema marginatum.

qs.q: What is the primary treatment of rheumatic fever (eradicating the streptococcus)?
qs.ex: الـ Penicillin.

qs.q: Which is NOT a sign or symptom of rheumatic fever?
qs.ex: الـ Nausea مش من علاماتها.

qs.q: A nurse is preparing child for discharge after diagnosed with rheumatic fever that is the following instruction
opts: Only give penicillin for dental work
Give penicillin for one month total
qs.ex: تعليمات الخروج: الـ penicillin يستمر لحد سن 21.

qs.q: Which of the following nursing diagnosis is most appropriate for child with rheumatic fever?
qs.ex: طفل الـ rheumatic fever: High risk for injury، بسبب الـ chorea ووجع المفاصل.

qs.q: In case of rheumatic heart fever with Myocarditis, the chest x-ray reveals normal heart size
qs.ex: غلط. لو فيه myocarditis القلب بيبان متضخم في الأشعة.

qs.q: Rheumatic fever is inflammation of the joints, heart, skin, and nervous system that occurs in children as a complication of untreated streptococcal infection of the throat. While most people with rheumatic fever recover, which part of the body may be permanently damaged in a small percentage of people?
qs.ex: القلب (الصمامات).

qs.q: Which of the following is usually the first symptom of rheumatic fever?
qs.ex: أول أعراض: وجع مفاصل وحرارة.

qs.q: Penicillin is safely given to patients by the IV route. (True / False)
qs.ex: غلط. الـ benzathine penicillin بيتدّي IM بس، والـ IV خطر.

qs.q: Each of the following drugs is used to treat rheumatic fever in children EXCEPT:
qs.ex: الـ Acetaminophen مسكّن ومش مضاد التهاب، فمش من علاجها.

qs.q: Patient with polyarthritis and carditis without evident of CHF (congestive heart failure) is treated with
qs.ex: مفاصل وcarditis من غير فشل قلب: Oral salicylates.

qs.q: Which symptom presented is NOT a sign of rheumatic fever?
qs.ex: الـ Changes in vision مش من علاماتها.

qs.q: Rheumatic fever is caused by which of the following bacteria?
qs.ex: السبب Streptococcus.

qs.q: Which of the following factors in the patient’s history and physical is LEAST relevant to the diagnosis of Rheumatic fever?
opts: Living in the current conditions of Flint, MI
The mother’s history of type-2 diabetes
A possible genetic factor from the father who’s history is unknown
qs.ex: سكر الأم ملوش علاقة بتشخيص الـ rheumatic fever.

qs.q: The provider suspects rheumatic fever and orders blood work. Which results indicate inflammation and cardiac involvement? (Select all that apply)
qs.ex: علامات الالتهاب: الـ CRP عالي وكرات الدم البيضا عالية.

qs.q: According to the Jones criteria, which sets of findings would indicate a positive diagnosis of rheumatic fever? (Select all that apply)
opts: Carditis, fever, and an elevated WBC count
Positive strep throat culture, arthritis, chorea
Recent scarlet fever, carditis, fever, arthralgia
qs.ex: التشخيص محتاج دليل على strep ومعاه (2 major) أو (1 major + 2 minor). الاختيار التاني: مزرعة إيجابية + arthritis + chorea. والتالت: scarlet fever + carditis + حرارة + arthralgia.

qs.q: Acute Rheumatic Fever (ARF) is primarily caused by which bacterial species?
qs.ex: Streptococcus pyogenes (Group A).

qs.q: Molecular mimicry in Acute Rheumatic Fever refers to:
opts: The ability of bacteria to mimic host cells.
The interaction between antibodies and antigens.
The cross-reactivity between bacterial antigens and host tissues.
The production of toxins by Streptococcus pyogenes.
qs.ex: الـ Molecular mimicry: أجزاء البكتيريا شبه أنسجة الجسم، فالمناعة بتهاجم الاتنين.

qs.q: Which of the following clinical manifestations is NOT a major criterion for diagnosing Acute Rheumatic Fever?
qs.ex: الـ CRP العالي minor.

qs.q: Patient with polyarthritis and carditis with evident cardiomegaly is treated with
qs.ex: مع تضخم القلب: Corticosteroid.

qs.q: Which of the following in not considered among supportive therapies for patient with carditis
qs.ex: مع الـ carditis بنقلّل السوايل والملح، مش بنزوّدهم.

qs.q: Which clinical manifestation of Acute Rheumatic Fever involves rapid, jerky movements and behavioral changes?
qs.ex: الحركات السريعة المتقطعة: Chorea.

qs.q: Which genetic marker can influence an individual's susceptibility to developing Acute Rheumatic Fever after a streptococcal infection?
opts: Genetic markers associated with the immune response
qs.ex: علامات جينية خاصة بالاستجابة المناعية.

qs.q: Which of the following is a major clinical manifestation of Acute Rheumatic Fever that involves inflammation of the heart?
qs.ex: Carditis.

qs.q: Which of the following is NOT a potential complication of Acute Rheumatic Fever?
qs.ex: الـ Meningitis مش من مضاعفاتها.

qs.q: Which of the following is a minor criterion for diagnosing Acute Rheumatic Fever?
qs.ex: حسب البنك Arthritis. المقصود الـ arthralgia (وجع من غير ورم)، وده minor. أما الـ polyarthritis فـ major.

qs.q: What is the gold standard for diagnosing Group A Streptococcus infection in the laboratory?
qs.ex: الـ Throat culture.

qs.q: Which of the following medications is NOT commonly used in the treatment of Acute Rheumatic Fever?
qs.ex: مضادات الـ Gram-negative مش مفيدة، لأن الـ strep بكتيريا Gram-positive.

qs.q: Rheumatic fever primarily affects which of the following body systems?
qs.ex: حسب البنك Musculoskeletal. بس أخطر ضرر بيبقى على القلب.

qs.q: Which of the following is the characteristic feature of rheumatic fever?
qs.ex: كلهم من علاماتها.

qs.q: Which of the following age groups are at higher risk for rheumatic fever? Select the correct answer
qs.ex: من 5 لـ 15 سنة.

qs.q: The best way to prevent rheumatic fever is:
opts: Early diagnosis and treatment of streptococcal infections
qs.ex: نشخّص التهاب الزور البكتيري ونعالجه بدري.

qs.q: Rheumatic fever can lead to long-term complications, primarily affecting the ......
qs.ex: القلب.

qs.q: The condition characterized by scarring and damage to the heart valves as a consequence of rheumatic fever is called ......
qs.ex: الـ Rheumatic heart disease.

qs.q: Rheumatic fever is an autoimmune reaction that follows infection with:
qs.ex: الـ Group A beta-hemolytic strep.

qs.q: Select ALL MAJOR Jones criteria.
qs.ex: الـ Major خمسة: Carditis، وPolyarthritis، وChorea، وErythema marginatum، وSubcutaneous nodules. الـ ESR minor.

qs.q: Secondary prophylaxis after rheumatic fever usually consists of:
opts: Benzathine penicillin IM every 3–4 weeks for years
qs.ex: حقن Benzathine penicillin IM كل 3–4 أسابيع لسنين.

qs.q: A child with RF has chorea. The priority nursing diagnosis is:
qs.ex: مع الـ chorea: Risk for injury.

qs.q: Which finding indicates carditis in a child with rheumatic fever?
opts: New heart murmur and tachycardia out of proportion to fever
qs.ex: الـ Carditis: murmur جديد ونبض سريع أكتر من اللي تبرره الحرارة.

qs.q: The joint involvement in rheumatic fever is typically:
opts: Migratory polyarthritis of large joints, non-deforming
qs.ex: migratory في المفاصل الكبيرة ومش بيسيب تشوّه.

qs.q: The nurse assessing a child with acute post-streptococcal glomerulonephritis should be alert for which finding?
qs.ex: بول لونه زي الشاي.

qs.q: A nurse is assigned to care for a child with nephrotic syndrome. Which important parameter should be assessed daily?
qs.ex: الـ nephrotic syndrome: نوزن الطفل يومياً علشان نتابع الـ edema.

qs.q: A parent of a child with glomerulonephritis asks why the urine is an abnormal color. The nurse's best response is:
opts: The urine is discolored because the child is receiving antihypertensives
There is blood in the child's urine that causes it to be tea-colored
Change of diet often causes the urine to be tea-colored
The child's urine is very concentrated, so it appears abnormal
qs.ex: الدم في البول هو اللي مغيّر لونه.

qs.q: Which area of potential disturbance should be a prime consideration when planning ongoing nursing care for a child with nephrotic syndrome?
qs.ex: الـ edema والـ steroids بيغيّروا شكل الطفل (وش منفوخ، moon face)، فصورة الجسم مشكلة مهمة.

qs.q: A parent asks the nurse how to prevent the child from having minimal change nephrotic syndrome again. The nurse's best response is:
opts: Keep the child away from sick playmates
It is rare for a child to have a relapse after recovery
Decrease sodium in the child's diet
qs.ex: الـ nephrotic syndrome بينتكس غالباً بعد عدوى، والـ steroids بتضعّف المناعة، فنبعّده عن الأطفال العيانين.

qs.q: Which of the following signs and symptoms are characteristic of nephrotic syndrome?
qs.ex: الـ nephrotic: شهية ضعيفة، وedema، وproteinuria.

qs.q: A parent asks the nurse how to prevent the child from having nephrotic syndrome again. The nurse's best response is:
opts: Decrease sodium in the child's diet
Keep the child away from sick playmates
It is rare for a child to have a relapse after recovery
qs.ex: الـ nephrotic syndrome بينتكس غالباً بعد عدوى، والـ steroids بتضعّف المناعة، فنبعّده عن الأطفال العيانين.

qs.q: Which finding typically is the earliest sign of improvement in a child with acute glomerulonephritis?
qs.ex: أول علامة تحسن في الـ AGN: البول يزيد.

qs.q: Nephrotic syndrome is primarily characterized by:
qs.ex: الـ nephrotic: بروتين كتير جداً في البول.

qs.q: The most common cause of nephrotic syndrome in children is:
qs.ex: أشهر سبب: Minimal change disease.

qs.q: A key difference between nephritis and nephrosis is:
opts: Inflammation is a main feature of nephritis
qs.ex: الفرق: الـ nephritis فيه التهاب.

qs.q: Which of the following is a complication of nephrotic syndrome?
qs.ex: المناعة ضعيفة، فبيتعرض للعدوى.

qs.q: Which diagnostic tool confirms kidney tissue damage?
qs.ex: الـ Kidney biopsy.

qs.q: Nephritis is commonly caused by:
qs.ex: حسب البنك: أمراض المناعة الذاتية.

qs.q: Which medication is used to manage high cholesterol in nephrosis?
qs.ex: الـ Atorvastatin للكوليسترول العالي.

qs.q: In nephritis, which symptom is common?
qs.ex: الـ nephritis: ضغط عالي.

qs.q: Which dietary recommendation is common for both nephritis and nephrosis?
qs.ex: أكل قليل البروتين وقليل الملح.

qs.q: What is the purpose of corticosteroids in nephritis treatment?
qs.ex: الـ steroids بتقلّل الالتهاب.

qs.q: The nurse a child with acute post streptococcal glomerulonephritis should be alert for which finding
qs.ex: بول لونه زي الشاي.

qs.q: Which finding typically is the earliest sign of improvement in case of child with acute glomerulonephritis
qs.ex: أول علامة تحسن في الـ AGN: البول يزيد.

qs.q: Glomerulonephritis refers to inflammation of the glomeruli of the kidneys. (True / False)
qs.ex: صح. التهاب في الـ glomeruli.

qs.q: Acute post-streptococcal GN (APSGN) is the less common post-infectious renal disease. (True / False)
qs.ex: غلط. الـ APSGN أشهر مرض كلوي بعد العدوى.

qs.q: Acute glomerulonephritis incidence in males to females is:
qs.ex: الذكور ضعف الإناث (2:1).

qs.q: The following are considered methods of diagnosing AGN:
qs.ex: كله بيساعد في التشخيص.

qs.q: Therapeutic treatment of AGN includes all of the following except
qs.ex: مضادات الهيستامين مش من علاج الـ AGN.

qs.q: A parent of a child with glomerulonephritis asks the nurse why the urine is abnormal color the nurse’s best response is
opts: The urine is discolored because the child is receiving antihypertensive
There is blood in the child’s urine that causes it to be tea colored
Change diet often causes the urine to be tea colored
Child’s urine is very concentrated so it appears to be abnormal
qs.ex: الدم في البول هو اللي مغيّر لونه.

qs.q: Nursing management of AGN includes
qs.ex: إجابة البنك: نقلّل البروتين. وكمان بنقلّل الصوديوم والسوايل، والبوتاسيوم لو البول قليل.

qs.q: A 5-year-old male with AGN has mild facial edema, tea-colored urine and BP 165/110. Which interventions will you include in his plan of care? (Select all that apply)
opts: Initiate and maintain a high-sodium diet daily
Encourage ambulation every 2 hours while awake
Assess color of urine after every void
Weigh the patient daily on a standing scale
Encourage the patient to consume 4 L of fluid per day
qs.ex: الـ AGN مع ضغط عالي: نتابع الـ intake والـ output كل ساعة، ونشوف لون البول، ونوزنه يومياً. ومفيش أكل مالح، ولا سوايل كتير، والطفل في راحة.

qs.q: While providing care to a pediatric patient with acute glomerulonephritis, you note the urine output to be 10 mL/hr. The patient weighs 30 lbs. As the nurse, you will want to limit what type of foods from the patient's diet?
opts: None of the above because the patient's urinary output is normal based on the patient's weight.
qs.ex: البول 10 مل/ساعة قليل لطفل وزنه 30 رطل، يعني oliguria، فنقلّل البوتاسيوم.

qs.q: A patient who is experiencing poststreptococcal glomerulonephritis has edema mainly in the face and around the eyes. As the nurse, you know to expect the edema to be more prominent during the?
qs.ex: الـ edema حوالين العين بيبقى أكتر الصبح.

qs.q: Which patient below is at MOST RISK for developing acute glomerulonephritis?
opts: A 3 year old male who has a positive ASO titer.
A 5 year old male who is recovering from an appendectomy.
An 18 year old male who is diagnosed with HIV.
A 6 year old female newly diagnosed with measles.
qs.ex: طفل عنده ASO titer إيجابي: عنده عدوى strep قريبة.

qs.q: Which of the following are NOT signs and symptoms of acute post-streptococcal glomerulonephritis? (Select all that apply)
opts: Mild swelling in the face or eyes
qs.ex: مش من علامات الـ APSGN: الضغط الواطي، وزيادة الـ GFR، والبروتين الكتير جداً.

qs.q: Post-streptococcal glomerulonephritis is a type of NEPHROTIC syndrome, meaning both RBCs and protein leak from the inflamed glomerulus. (True / False)
qs.ex: غلط. الـ APSGN نوع nephritic، مش nephrotic.

qs.q: Within the past month, the admission rate of patients with poststreptococcal glomerulonephritis has doubled on your unit. You are proving an in-service to your colleagues about this condition. Which statement is CORRECT about this condition?
opts: "This condition tends to present 6 months after a strep infection of the throat or skin."
"It is important the patient consumes a diet rich in potassium based foods due to the risk of hypokalemia."
"Patients are less likely to experience hematuria with this condition."

"This condition is not caused by the streptococcal bacteria attacking the glomerulus, but by the immune system’s response to the bacteria by creating an antigen-antibody complex which inflames the glomerulus."
qs.ex: الـ APSGN مش البكتيريا اللي بتهاجم الكلية. المناعة بتعمل complexes (antigen-antibody) بتلتهب في الـ glomerulus.

qs.q: Glomerulonephritis (nephritic syndrome) is a kidney disorder. This disorder affects the glomeruli (clusters of microscopic blood vessels with small pores through which blood is filtered). Glomerulonephritis is characterized by swelling (edema), high blood pressure, and which of the following?
qs.ex: كرات دم حمرا في البول.

qs.q: Acute glomerulonephritis most often occurs as a complication of which of the following?
qs.ex: بعد عدوى strep.

qs.q: Urinalysis results include proteinuria, many red blood cells and red blood cell casts, and 1-2 white blood cells per high power field. Which of the following diseases best fits with these findings?
qs.ex: بروتين، وكرات حمرا، وRBC casts: Acute post-streptococcal GN.

qs.q: The nurse is caring for a child admitted with acute glomerulonephritis. Which of the following clinical manifestations would likely have been noted in the child with this diagnosis?
qs.ex: بول لونه زي الدخان (smoky).

qs.q: A child diagnosed acute glomerulonephritis will most likely have a history of which of the following?
opts: Recent illness such as strep throat
Hemorrhage or history of bruising easily
Sibling diagnosed with the same disease
Hearing loss with impaired speech development
qs.ex: التهاب زور قريب.

qs.q: A school nurse is trying to prevent poststreptococcal glomerulonephritis in children. Which of the following would be the best way to prevent this?
opts: Prophylactic antibiotics after strep throat are important.
Tell parents to give ibuprofen if their child has a sore throat.
All children in the child's class should be tested for strep throat if there is a positive.
Encourage the child to take all the antibiotics if diagnosed with strep throat.
qs.ex: نشجّع الطفل يكمّل المضاد الحيوي لو عنده strep.

qs.q: You obtain a history from the mother of a child with glomerulonephritis about how he became ill. Which of the following would you expect her to tell you she noticed?
qs.ex: بول بني غامق.

qs.q: The caregiver of a child being treated at home for acute glomerulonephritis calls the nurse reporting that her daughter has just had a convulsion. The child is resting comfortably but the caregiver would like to know what to do. The nurse would instruct the caregiver to do which of the following actions?
opts: Give the child fluids and report back to the nurse in a few hours.
Take the child's blood pressure and report the findings to the nurse while the nurse is still on the phone.
Give the child a diuretic and report back to the nurse in a few hours.
Weigh the child in the same clothes
qs.ex: التشنج غالباً من الضغط العالي، فالأم تقيس الضغط على طول وتبلّغ وهي على التليفون.

qs.q: A symptom often seen in acute glomerulonephritis is edema. The most common site the edema is first noted is in which area of the body?
qs.ex: الـ edema بيبدأ حوالين العين.

qs.q: A child has been admitted to the hospital with a diagnosis of acute glomerulonephritis. During history-taking the nurse first asks the child's parents about a recent history of:
qs.ex: عدوى strep.

qs.q: The child has been diagnosed to have glomerulonephritis. What should the nurse observe in the urine?
qs.ex: دم.

qs.q: You're collecting a urine sample on a patient who is experiencing proteinuria due to nephrotic syndrome. As the nurse, you know the urine will appear:
qs.ex: البول بيبقى غامق وفيه رغوة.

qs.q: The characteristic features of nephrotic syndrome are?
opts: Heavy proteinuria (greater than 3.5 g/24 hr in adults or 40 mg/sq.m/hr in children)
qs.ex: كلهم.

qs.q: Which of the following are uncommon findings in a patient with idiopathic nephrotic syndrome?
qs.ex: مش شائع في الـ minimal change: الضغط العالي، والدم الواضح في البول.

qs.q: Which of the following statements about nephrotic syndrome are true?
opts: Most children (90%) with nephrotic syndrome have a form of idiopathic nephrotic syndrome
Minimal change disease (85%) is the most common cause of idiopathic nephrotic syndrome
The remaining 10% who do not have idiopathic NS have secondary NS related to systemic or glomerular diseases such as membranous nephropathy or membranoproliferative glomerulonephritis
All the above statements are true
qs.ex: كلهم صح.

qs.q: A patient is diagnosed with nephrotic syndrome. Which signs and symptoms are common in this condition?
qs.ex: كلهم.

qs.q: Select the most common type of medications that may be ordered by a physician to treat nephrotic syndrome:
qs.ex: الـ Corticosteroids.

qs.q: Each of the following features are characteristic of the nephrotic syndrome except:
qs.ex: الـ nephrotic من غير ضغط عالي. فالـ Hypertension هي الاستثناء.

qs.q: The child with nephrotic syndrome who has ascites and difficulty breathing is probably most comfortable sleeping in which position?
qs.ex: الـ Fowler's.

qs.q: In caring for a child with nephrotic syndrome, which of the following interventions will be included in the child's plan of care?
opts: Ambulating three to four times a day
Testing the urine for glucose levels regularly
Increasing fluid intake by 50 cc an hour
Weighing on the same scale each day
qs.ex: نوزنه على نفس الميزان كل يوم.

qs.q: The nurse is caring for a child with nephrotic syndrome. The child is noted to have edema. The edema would most likely be seen where on this child?
qs.ex: العين والكاحل.

qs.q: The nurse is caring for an 8-year-old hospitalized child with nephrotic syndrome. Which of the following nursing interventions would be appropriate for this child?
opts: Test the urine for ketones twice a day
Weigh the child once a week.
qs.ex: نقيس محيط البطن يومياً.

qs.q: An 11-year-old boy presents to your office with pitting edema and proteinuria exceeding 3.5g in 24 hours. You suspect that this patient has experienced a loss of polyanions in his glomerular basement membranes. Which of the following findings would confirm your diagnosis?
opts: Negatively birefringent crystals in the urine
qs.ex: فقد الـ polyanions بيعمل Selective albuminuria.

qs.q: Three-year-old Carlo has been admitted to the pediatric unit with a tentative diagnosis of nephrotic syndrome. The diagnosis of Idiopathic Nephrotic Syndrome has been confirmed. Which unexpected finding would the nurse report?
qs.ex: الدم في البول مش متوقع في الـ idiopathic nephrotic.

qs.q: Three-year-old Carlo has been admitted to the pediatric unit with a tentative diagnosis of nephrotic syndrome. Carlo's potential for impairment of skin integrity is related to:
qs.ex: الـ edema.

qs.q: Prednisone is prescribed for Carlo. The nurse evaluate its effectiveness by
opts: Weighing him each morning before breakfast
qs.ex: بنقيّم الـ prednisone بإننا نكشف على البروتين في البول.

qs.q: A 6 year old male is diagnosed with nephrotic syndrome. In your nursing care plan you will include which of the following as a nursing diagnosis for this patient?
qs.ex: Risk for infection.

qs.q: Which patient below is NOT at risk for developing nephrotic syndrome?
opts: An 8 year old male with diabetes mellitus.
A 5 year old female diagnosed with minimal change disease.
A 10 year old male with Lupus.
A 7 year old male recently diagnosed with Goodpasture's Syndrome.
qs.ex: الـ Goodpasture بيعمل nephritic مش nephrotic.

qs.q: The mother of a child recently diagnosed with nephrotic syndrome asks how to identify early signs of relapse. You tell her to monitor the child for:
opts: Protein in the urine using an over-the-counter kit
Swelling in the legs, hands, face, or abdomen
qs.ex: علامات الانتكاس: بروتين في البول (بشريط) وتورم.

qs.q: A student describes the signs and symptoms of nephrotic syndrome. Which statements require re-education? (Select all that apply)
qs.ex: محتاجين نصحح: بروتين قليل، وبول زي الشاي، وضغط عالي. دول مش من علامات الـ nephrotic.

qs.q: You're providing care to a 6-year-old male patient who is receiving treatment for nephrotic syndrome. Which assessment finding below requires you to notify the physician immediately?
opts: Redden area on the patient's left leg that is swollen and warm
Elevated lipid level on morning labs
Urine test results that shows proteinuria
qs.ex: رجل حمرا ووارمة وسخنة: احتمال cellulitis أو جلطة، فنبلّغ.

qs.q: As the nurse, you know that it is important to implement a low sodium diet for a patient with nephrotic syndrome. However, it is important to implement what other type of diet due to another complication associated with this syndrome?
qs.ex: أكل قليل الدهون، بسبب الكوليسترول العالي.

qs.q: A parent asks the nurse how to prevent the child from having minimal change nephrotic syndrome again the nurse’s best response
opts: Keep the child away from sick playmates
It is rare for a child to have a relapse after recovery
qs.ex: الـ nephrotic syndrome بينتكس غالباً بعد عدوى، والـ steroids بتضعّف المناعة، فنبعّده عن الأطفال العيانين.

qs.q: Which of the following signs and symptoms are characteristics of the nephrotic syndrome?
qs.ex: شهية ضعيفة، وedema، وproteinuria.

qs.q: A parent asks the nurse how to prevent the child form having nephrotic syndrome again the nurse’s best response is
opts: Keep the child away from sick playmates
It is rare a child to have a relapse after recovery
qs.ex: الـ nephrotic syndrome بينتكس غالباً بعد عدوى، والـ steroids بتضعّف المناعة، فنبعّده عن الأطفال العيانين.

qs.q: Which of the following areas of potential disturbances should be a prime consideration when planning ongoing nursing care for child with nephrotic syndrome
qs.ex: صورة الجسم.

qs.q: Nephrotic syndrome is a clinical state that characterized by
qs.ex: كلهم.

qs.q: Secondary NS is idiopathic nephrosis or minimal change nephrotic syndrome
qs.ex: غلط. الـ idiopathic (minimal change) primary، مش secondary.

qs.q: All of the following considered therapeutic management of nephrotic syndrome except
qs.ex: المسكّنات مش من علاجه.

qs.q: Relapse considered one of complication of NS
qs.ex: صح. الانتكاس من مضاعفاته.

qs.q: The classic triad of nephrotic syndrome includes:
qs.ex: بروتين كتير، وألبومين واطي، وedema.

qs.q: A child with AGN has tea-colored urine. The nurse explains this is due to:
qs.ex: الـ Hematuria.

qs.q: Select ALL appropriate nursing actions for a child with nephrotic syndrome.
opts: Weigh daily on the same scale
qs.ex: الـ nephrotic: نوزنه يومياً، ونقيس البطن، ونحميه من العدوى، وعناية بالجلد. مفيش أكل مالح.

qs.q: AGN most commonly follows which infection?
opts: Group A beta-hemolytic streptococcal throat or skin infection
qs.ex: عدوى strep في الزور أو الجلد.

qs.q: The earliest sign of improvement in AGN is:
qs.ex: البول يزيد.

qs.q: The first-line drug for idiopathic (minimal change) nephrotic syndrome is:
qs.ex: الـ Prednisone.

qs.q: (Matching) Grade I respiratory distress is manifested by:
qs.ex: Grade I: نفس سريع وفتحات المناخير بتتفتح وتتقفل.

qs.q: (Matching) Grade II respiratory distress is manifested by:
qs.ex: Grade II: retractions بين الضلوع وتحتها.

qs.q: (Matching) Grade III respiratory distress is manifested by:
qs.ex: Grade III: grunting مع الزفير.

qs.q: (Matching) Grade IV respiratory distress is manifested by:
qs.ex: Grade IV: زرقان وتغيّر في الوعي.

qs.q: Which of the following findings would alert the nurse to notify the primary health care provider when assessing the neonate?
qs.ex: الـ Sternal retraction علامة ضيق نفس، فنبلّغ.

qs.q: Which of the following is a specific treatment of respiratory distress syndrome?
qs.ex: العلاج النوعي: Surfactant.

qs.q: A neonate's oral cavity is filled with mucus and he became cyanosed. What is the first action of the nurse?
qs.ex: بقه مليان مخاط وزرق: أول حاجة نشفط.

qs.q: The nurse could teach the parents that the main function of surfactant is to:
qs.ex: الـ surfactant بيمنع الحويصلات تقفل.

qs.q: Which assessment signs alert the nurse to the possibility of respiratory distress syndrome?
opts: The presence of a barrel chest
qs.ex: Tachypnea وretractions.

qs.q: Which nursing diagnosis is priority for a preterm infant with respiratory distress syndrome?
qs.ex: التشخيص الأساسي: Impaired gas exchange.

qs.q: While developing a plan of care for a newborn with RDS, which is considered the main nursing diagnosis?
qs.ex: التشخيص الأساسي: Impaired gas exchange.

qs.q: An early sign of neonatal respiratory distress syndrome is grunting. (True / False)
qs.ex: غلط. الـ grunting علامة متأخرة (Grade III). المبكرة الـ tachypnea.

qs.q: A neonate’s oral cavity is filled with mucus and he became cyanosed what is the first action of the nurse to do
qs.ex: نشفط.

qs.q: The major main aim of surfactant therapy is as follow
qs.ex: الـ surfactant بيقلّل التوتر السطحي في الحويصلات.

qs.q: In which weeks of gestation of the following for starting corticosteroid therapy for pregnant women to overcome fetal lung prematurity
qs.ex: الـ corticosteroids للحامل من 24 لـ 34 أسبوع.

qs.q: Which of the following findings would alert the nurse to notify the primary health care provider when assessing the neonates?
qs.ex: الـ Sternal retraction علامة ضيق نفس، فنبلّغ.

qs.q: The preterm infant is diagnosed with respiratory distress syndrome which is caused by alteration in the body’s secretion of
qs.ex: الـ RDS سببها نقص الـ Surfactant.

qs.q: Hyaline membrane disease also called RDS
qs.ex: صح. الـ Hyaline membrane disease هو الـ RDS.

qs.q: All of the following considered risk factors of RDS except
qs.ex: حسب البنك: «Limited birth» مش من عوامل الخطر. البرد والسكر والولادة المبكرة عوامل خطر.

qs.q: Which of the following is considered a physiological abnormality of RDS?
qs.ex: التهوية في الحويصلات بتقل.

qs.q: Intercostal retraction is a sign to diagnose which grade of RDS
qs.ex: الـ Intercostal retraction: Grade 2.

qs.q: Antenatal corticosteroid therapy are indicated in pregnant women 24 – 34 week’s gestation at high risk of preterm delivery within the next 7 days
qs.ex: صح.

qs.q: Type of surfactant that is an extract of calf lung:
qs.ex: الـ Infasurf من رئة العجل. الـ Survanta من رئة البقر، والـ Curosurf من الخنزير.

qs.q: What of the following consider nursing diagnosis of patient with RDS
opts: Imbalanced nutrition less than body requirements
qs.ex: كلهم.

qs.q: RDS is the most common cause of respiratory distress in premature infants, correlating with structural and functional immaturity of the heart. (True / False)
qs.ex: غلط. مرتبطة بعدم نضج الرئة، مش القلب.

qs.q: The more the gestational age and birth weight, the more the incidence of RDS. (True / False)
qs.ex: غلط. كل ما العمر والوزن يزيدوا الـ RDS بيقل.

qs.q: It's alse known as hyaline membrane disease:
qs.ex: الـ RDS.

qs.q: Pulmonary surfactant production begins at
qs.ex: الـ surfactant بيبدأ يتعمل في الأسبوع 24.

qs.q: Infants born after 32 weeks have a much higher chance of survival than those born at 24 weeks.
qs.ex: صح.

qs.q: Adequate amounts of pulmonary surfactant is produced to prevent atelectasis at about
qs.ex: كمية كفاية في الأسبوع 32.

qs.q: All of the following are considered predisposing and risk factor of RDS, Except:
qs.ex: الأنثى مش عامل خطر، الذكر هو اللي عامل خطر.

qs.q: In RDS, Mortality rate increases with decreasing gestational age and in LBW newborns.
qs.ex: صح.

qs.q: Mature levels of pulmonary surfactant are usually present after
qs.ex: بيكمل نضج بعد الأسبوع 35.

qs.q: In RDS, the interference with gas exchange results in which of the following except:
qs.ex: الـ pH بيقل مش بيزيد، لأنه acidosis.

qs.q: A newborn infant with RDS may be presented with which of the following, except:
qs.ex: الضغط العالي مش منها.

qs.q: In most cases of RDS, symptoms and signs reach a peak within 3 days
qs.ex: صح. أشد حاجة في أول 3 أيام.

qs.q: Which of the following electrolytes imbalance associated with RDS:
qs.ex: الـ Metabolic acidosis.

qs.q: A preterm infant presented with dyspnea, fatigue, nasal flaring, expiratory retraction, his respiratory rate is 85br/min, according to the S&S of the infant, the infant is in which grade of RD:
qs.ex: حسب البنك: Grade II.

qs.q: Neonatal respiratory distress syndrome (NRDS):
opts: Occurs in ~50% of premature births with a weight of <1500 g
Always follows premature births before 30-week gestation
Is commonly treated by giving the neonate corticosteroids
Occurs in 1 in 300 of all births.
qs.ex: بتحصل في حوالي 50% من المبتسرين اللي أقل من 1500 جم.

qs.q: Four 38-week-gestation gravidas have just delivered. Which of the babies should be monitored closely by the nurse for respiratory distress?
opts: The baby whose mother has diabetes mellitus.
The baby whose mother has lung cancer.
The baby whose mother has hypothyroidism.
The baby whose mother has asthma.
qs.ex: طفل الأم اللي عندها سكر: الـ surfactant بيتأخر.

qs.q: A newborn infant is presented by the following S&S, RR 70 br/min, mild retraction, no cyanosis, mild decrease in air entry, and audible grunting by stethoscope, according to Downe's score, the evaluation of this infant and his diagnosis is:
qs.ex: حسب Downes: النفس 70 = 1، والـ retraction الخفيف = 1، ومفيش زرقان = 0، ونقص بسيط في دخول الهوا = 1، والـ grunting بالسماعة = 1. المجموع 4، يعني respiratory distress.

qs.q: For the prevention of RDS, the following measures are done, except:
qs.ex: الـ Beta blockers مش من الوقاية.

qs.q: A 1,000-gram neonate is being admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit. The surfactant Survanta (beractant) has just been prescribed to prevent respiratory distress syndrome. Which of the following actions should the nurse take while administering this medication?
opts: Flush the intravenous line with normal saline solution.
Assist the neonatologist during the intubation procedure.
Inject the medication deep into the vastus lateralis muscle.
Administer the reconstituted liquid via an oral syringe.
qs.ex: الـ surfactant بيتدّي من الأنبوبة، فنساعد في الـ intubation.

qs.q: A 30-week-gestation neonate, 2 hours old, has received Survanta (beractant). Which of the following would indicate a positive response to the medication?
qs.ex: تشبع الأكسجين 96% معناه إن الطفل استجاب كويس.

qs.q: Administration of corticosteroids to women 48 hours before delivery of fetuses helps:
qs.ex: الـ steroids بتحفّز الـ surfactant، وبتنضّج الرئة، وبتقلّل الـ RDS. كلهم.

qs.q: For newborn with RDS, aiming to keep pO2 between
qs.ex: الـ pO2 من 50 لـ 80.

qs.q: For an infant with RDS the proper position is:
qs.ex: الوضع: Semi-Fowler's.

qs.q: The major main aim of surfactant therapy is:
qs.ex: الـ surfactant بيقلّل التوتر السطحي في الحويصلات.

qs.q: The primary cause of RDS in preterm infants is:
qs.ex: نقص الـ Surfactant.

qs.q: Which is an EARLY sign of RDS?
qs.ex: علامة مبكرة: Tachypnea.

qs.q: Select ALL risk factors for RDS.
qs.ex: عوامل الخطر: الولادة المبكرة، وسكر الأم، والبرد، والاختناق. أما الأنثى فلأ.

qs.q: Antenatal corticosteroids are given to mothers at risk of preterm delivery between:
qs.ex: من 24 لـ 34 أسبوع.

qs.q: Surfactant replacement is administered via:
qs.ex: من الـ Endotracheal tube.

qs.q: The expected ABG in an infant with RDS is:
qs.ex: Respiratory وmetabolic acidosis.
